purpose: 硬件耦合拓扑 SWAP 路由开销与 PennyLane default.mixed 去极化噪声基准（QCNN SPT + IQP MNIST）

protocol.router: Deterministic bidirectional SABRE-style SWAP router (Li, Ding, Xie, ASPLOS 2019; 1 SWAP = 3 physical CNOTs)
protocol.noise_model: PennyLane default.mixed local depolarizing channel (p_2q) on BOTH qubits after every physical 2Q gate (including all 3 CNOTs per inserted SWAP) + optional BitFlip(p_ro) readout ablation
protocol.iqp_kernel_definition: Exact Hilbert-Schmidt overlap Tr(rho(x) rho(x')) on default.mixed density matrices (exact match to |<psi(x)|psi(x')>|^2 at p_2q=0; guaranteed PSD)
protocol.qcnn_mixed_equivalence: Exact Heisenberg-picture POVM propagation on default.mixed (verified <1e-10 vs forward per-state default.mixed)
